data.desc: Riskified (NYSE: RSKD) empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by outsmarting risk. Many of the world's largest brands and publicly traded online sellers use Riskified to protect against chargebacks, combat fraud and policy abuse, and improve customer retention. Its AI-driven platform, built by a team of ecommerce risk specialists, analyzes the person behind each interaction to deliver real-time decisions and identity-based insights.
